headline_defects_proved.d1_dead_term_is_the_constant_zero: dead_symbols() only emits in-degree-0 symbols, so reverse(s)={} for every s in the predicted-dead set, the 'proven' bucket's guard (reverse(s)!={} AND ...) is FALSE AND _, and proven is empty for EVERY graph and EVERY predictor. Measured: strict_term_proven=[] and strict_term_reverse_nonempty=[] for all three rows. Compounding: the `if |dead| else 1.0` fallback pays a predictor that reports NOTHING dead a perfect 20/20, so the term's range is exactly {0.0, 1.0}. Run 3 called this 'unidentified under a held-out oracle'; it is a constant. eq row 13.
headline_defects_proved.d2_run3_f1_proposal_REFUTED_and_retracte: Run 3 proposed 30*F1 on the grounds that F1 is a lower bound against a partial oracle. False: prec_D<=prec_T holds (|P| fixed) but rec_D<=rec_T does NOT (D={1,2},T={1,2,3,4,5},P={1,2,6} => rec_D=1.0 > rec_T=0.4), and F1 is monotone increasing in r (dF1/dr=2p^2/(p+r)^2>0), so it inherits the sign-indefinite term. Precision is KEPT precisely because it is the only well-posed direction. Retracted numbers retained in the log under harness_score_f1_RETRACTED (64.55/62.40/68.30). eq row 14.

repair: Trace-free certification instead of trace-derived dead accuracy. opaque = bare names of all unresolved call sites; certified = predicted-dead minus every symbol whose bare name matches an opaque name. Zero false positives under the resolver's own soundness, and no execution required. Precondition CHECKED not assumed: a '<complex>' site (call with no extractable callee name, e.g. factory()()) makes the name filter unsound, so the term refuses to score. The precondition FAILS on 3 of 5 real repos (flask, requests, rich). eq rows 15-16.
non_identifiability_result: struct_precision_evaluable is 1.0 for ALL THREE rows while struct_precision spans 0.4286-0.6; the entire difference is unadjudicable edges (2/4/4) -- predicted edges whose caller no fold exercised, which the oracle cannot adjudicate whether real or fabricated. The standing ranking (control 67.55 > mode_b 66.21 > mode_a 62.40) is therefore produced entirely by unadjudicated edges. ranking_identifiable=False is now emitted with a caveat. No aggregator repairs this: precision, F1, min(p,r) and Youden's J are all monotone in the same two contaminated ratios. eq row 17.
reported_against_interest: All three rows certify the SAME single symbol (cache.Cache.stale), so the repair changes what the 20 points MEAN (noise -> sound verdict) and does NOT change which variant wins. The repaired term is 1.0 by construction and is a binary soundness verdict, not a graded signal; the informative certification_rate (0.2/0.3333/0.3333) is reported and deliberately UNSCORED because it rewards shrinking the dead set toward nothing.
prior_art_check: closest art found by me, not hidden: (i) arXiv:2606.09376 Santillana 2026 states verbatim that precision-only metrics reward abstention and resolves it by building a COMPLETE oracle -- unavailable here since T is not enumerable, and it never touches program analysis; (ii) Kalibera & Jones ISSTA 2019 (ACM 3377811.3380441) measures call-graph recall against an incomplete behavioural oracle (median 0.884, 31 Java programs) and names 'invocations initiated by the JVM, without matching call sites' -- structurally the same hole as the <complex> sentinel; (iii) over-approximating unresolved call sites is standard for RECALL (Go VTA, WALA, Closure, Soot) but is never used to gate a DEAD-CODE verdict, and never name-based rather than type/points-to based; (iv) arXiv:2507.00057 (incoherence = provable lower bound without an oracle) shows lower-bound-without-oracle evaluation is active. Not in any of them: the proof that a natural dead-code accuracy-over-prediction-set term is identically zero, the opaque-name certification with its checked precondition, the entry-point-fold unadjudicability condition. novelty 57/100 -> engineering track, no LaTeX paper.

headline_kill: Run 4's certification gate is UNSOUND and its stated 'zero false positives' is withdrawn (eq row 18, node N7b). On synthetic_taint_repo the ungated filter certifies 4 symbols of which 2 are FALSE POSITIVES, by two mechanisms a NAME-based opaque filter cannot see: the string-literal escape (globals()["s"]) and scope (the opaque set is built from the analysis set, which skips tests/, so a test-only reference is invisible). On real repos the demonstrated out-of-scope-reference count is flask 80/111, requests 43/84, rich 120/198 and sqlmodel 107/195 -- and sqlmodel is the ONE real repo where run 4's precondition holds and its gate actually fires, so those 107 are demonstrated, not counterfactual. The global <complex> refusal was not a soundness mechanism; it was the only thing keeping a 55%-false-positive gate switched off, and the single repo where it switched on is where the gate failed. The formula is retained and still measured in src/03_metric_gate.py; only the soundness claim dies.
repair: Replace the global precondition with an occurrence count over the whole reference corpus: certified = {s in dead : occ[leaf(s)] == 1}, counting NAME tokens AND identifier-shaped STRING tokens. Sound because every mechanism that can put a reference to s into the program names s somewhere in the source. Structurally immune to both holes above: there is no opaque-name set to escape and no scope to fall outside of. The <complex> clause disappears entirely, so the term stops refusing on real code -- it now certifies 4/22/22/27 on flask/requests/sqlmodel/rich where run 4 certified 0/0/195/0.
reported_against_interest: The new rule certifies 22 on sqlmodel where run 4's GATED gate certifies 195, so on raw count the replacement looks like a 9x regression. It is not: 107 of those 195 are demonstrated false positives. 22 sound verdicts beats 88 unsound ones. The rule's real cost is its conservatism -- certification_rate is 2-20% on real repos -- and n_blocked_by_string_only is 0-3 everywhere, meaning the blockers are __all__ entries and same-name collisions rather than real callers. That is queued as N9, not claimed as a win.

headline: N10 was killed on prior art before it was built: its manifest IS Vulture's whitelist, whose documented matching bug (bare-name global set, issue #430) this loop had already rediscovered as run 6's stale convention list. Its one measured hypothesis then returned a FALSE POSITIVE (precision 0.0), in the unsound direction. The structural replacement needs no name list at all: the inheritance edge is the witness, it closes 4 of 4 run-6 residuals for 9 certificates, and it is a no-op on every fixture. And the base witness FAILS on the protocol fixture, which is the result: two symbols with provably identical in-corpus evidence differ in liveness, so no in-corpus-only gate can exceed 1/2 on that pair.

new_theorem_n11.statement: getattr-by-protocol-name dispatch is undecidable from a finite corpus with no interface declaration. Two symbols with equal in-corpus evidence (occ==1, no export witness, no inheritance edge, no string mention, no path or name convention) can differ in liveness, so any deterministic in-corpus-only gate has accuracy <= 1/2 on the discriminating pair. The reflection interface is therefore IRREDUCIBLY EXTERNAL: a declared interface is not a tuning knob, it is the only carrier of the missing bit.

metrics.n11_bound_proof: PROVEN, and it is a tautology stated as a bound: a sound gate certifies only from D so |TP|<=4, and both extremal actions score 4/8. No enumeration is required, and 19683 gates is brute-force corroboration, not the proof.
metrics.n11_dichotomy_premise_sharpened: EXACTNESS requires the feature space to be LITERALLY symmetric across L and D (all 8 evidence vectors the same constant vector). A weaker premise -- equal on 9 chosen features while other features vary -- breaks exactness and yields only the weaker guarantee that abstain-all is available. The bound 0.5 survives either way; the TWO-POINT dichotomy does not.
metrics.interface_lower_bound_formula: ceil(log2(n_ambiguous_classes)) per repo; the total is the SUM of per-repo logs, which equals log2 of the PRODUCT, so the two accountings coincide. The direction is preserved: a lower bound that is too small keeps '>= 2' sound.

n11_defect_v_soundness_repair.defect: the SIXTH self-inflicted defect and the only one that reached a published closed form. max_accuracy_over_gates scored AGREEMENT with the truth (g(features[s]) == lasso[s]) and maximised over ALL gates with no admissibility condition, then reported the result as 'max_accuracy'. Agreement is not soundness: a gate that certifies every symbol scores high agreement by being wrong about exactly the symbols the dead-code term exists to protect. The reported maximum was therefore attained by the LEAST trustworthy gate in the family, and every interface-value claim built on it inherited that.
n11_defect_v_soundness_repair.found_by: an adversarial math verification sub-agent asked to refute the claim set, which asked the question the five self-checks never did: what IS a bit, and is the achiever sound? Then confirmed by enumeration, not by reasoning.
n11_defect_v_soundness_repair.why_it_survived_five_self_checks: the two curves agree exactly at j=0 -- both are the majority rule max(|D|,|L|)/|C| -- so the defect is invisible on the only row the earlier checks asserted. It appears only above zero external bits.
n11_defect_v_soundness_repair.agreement_achieved_by: ~f9 -- the conjunction that certifies every unflagged symbol, which certifies n_live - j LIVE symbols at every row above the last
n11_defect_v_soundness_repair.sound_achieved_by: f8 -- abstain on the unflagged remainder; sound at every row
n11_defect_v_soundness_repair.closed_form_sound: accuracy = n_live/|C| for j < n_live, and 1.0 at j = n_live. A bit identifying a LIVE symbol licenses exactly ONE abstention and nothing else, because 'not flagged' is not 'dead': the interface is a LOWER bound on liveness, so a threshold rule that certifies the unflagged remainder is unsound, not optimal.
n11_defect_v_soundness_repair.consequence_for_the_central_claim: the headline 'one correct external bit is worth exactly 1/|C|' is a property of an UNSOUND gate family. Under soundness the first n_live - 1 bits are worth EXACTLY ZERO and the last bit is worth the entire remaining gap (0.5 on a balanced class of 8). A class of size 8 needs 8 bits to be certain, and only the last one buys anything.
n11_defect_v_soundness_repair.run7_manifest_0.875_still_explained: the killed protocol manifest lands on the AGREEMENT curve at j=3 (0.875 predicted, 0.875 measured, prediction_holds=True), and its sound value at the same j is 0.5. That is the correct reading and it is unfavourable: 0.875 was an agreement number measured on a gate with one demonstrated false positive, so the law predicts it while licensing nothing. The number is explained; the verdict is not vindicated.
n11_defect_v_soundness_repair.repair: max_accuracy_over_gates gained sound_only, restricting the search to gates with g(s) => lasso[s] for all s -- the same admissibility condition every other soundness claim in the module already used. interface_value_curve now emits both curves with both closed forms and per-row achiever names. The agreement curve is retained under its own name because it is the curve that predicts run 7's number.

n11b_class_level_declaration_retraction.retracted_claim: a class-level declaration (class T(Protocol), @runtime_checkable, a written base class, __all__, a docstring) is worth EXACTLY ZERO bits, because it is constant on the class and hence constant on the class's evidence
n11b_class_level_declaration_retraction.fault_1_mislabelled_arm: the control appended ONE value to EVERY symbol, so it measured a GLOBAL constant and reported it under the name class_level. The name asserted a mechanism the control did not exercise.
n11b_class_level_declaration_retraction.fault_2_inverted_predicate: the first replacement counted classes SPANNING two E-classes, which buys nothing, instead of E-classes SPLIT across two or more Python classes, which is the only way a per-class value separates two symbols. It reported 4/6/6/5 and would have appeared to SUPPORT the retracted claim.
n11b_class_level_declaration_retraction.corrected_statement: a per-class declaration buys lift exactly when it splits an E-class; the lift is zero iff the class partition COARSENS the E-class partition. Constancy on the evidence fibre forbids strict non-empty certification (score <= max(|L|,|D|)/|C|), and that is a statement about the E-class, not the Python class.
n11b_class_level_declaration_retraction.verdict: REFUTED on all four real repos; the retracted zero is WITHDRAWN. Not marginally: 29-100% of E-classes are split by the class partition, covering 201/110/243/409 predicted-dead symbols.
n11b_class_level_declaration_retraction.corroboration_from_run7: run 7's inheritance witness IS a per-class declaration and it removed 9 real-repo certificates. A globally constant feature cannot remove 9 certificates in 4 different places, so run 7's own shipped result already contradicted the retracted zero. The loop shipped the refutation a run before it measured the reason.
n11b_class_level_declaration_retraction.p4_verdict_prior_art: PRIOR_ART_STANDARD -- a classifier is constant on a fibre of its feature map is textbook, and needs no experiment. The module's own header said so and then ran the experiment anyway.

n11c_mislabelled_keys.defect: interface_cost_bits emitted arbitrary_code_bits and allowlist_code_bits. The values are log2 C(|C|,|D_C|) and nu(M) -- SPECIFICATION/information bits, not source-code bytes. 6.129283 = log2 C(8,4) = log2 70, reproduced exactly.
n11c_mislabelled_keys.secondary: the docstring said the allowlist costs log2 C(|C|,|L_C|) while the loop accumulated log2 C(|C|,|D_C|). The two are the same NUMBER (C(n,|D|) = C(n,|L|)) but only one of them names what the code computes, and the module's stated discipline is that a name may not overclaim.
n11c_mislabelled_keys.why_the_adversarial_reviewer_called_it_a: comparing 1 partition bit against 6.13 'code' bits is only incoherent if the units differ. They do not: both are specification bits, so the comparison is FAIR and the conclusion (the allowlist is at least as expensive, gap 5.129283) stands. The reviewer's objection was to the NAME, not the arithmetic.
n11c_mislabelled_keys.repair: keys renamed to arbitrary_spec_bits / allowlist_spec_bits, with an explicit bits_are field; the old keys retained and marked RETRACTED so the stale run-8 artefact stays diffable

N12_premise_is_N11cs_law.mechanism: a declaration need not identify a LIVE symbol; it may isolate a DEAD one, and a pure-dead block is certifiable at precision 1 by a sound gate
N12_premise_is_N11cs_law.scope_of_the_retraction: N11c is CORRECT for flag partitions and all 4 flag rows of the 8-method fixture agree with it. The flatness is a property of flag partitions: a flag splits a fibre into flagged / not-flagged and the not-flagged half still holds every dead symbol. Run 9's enumeration only built flag partitions, so the law described its own hypothesis class.
N12_premise_is_N11cs_law.not_a_refutation_at_the_2_symbol_scale: run 7's discriminating pair has 2 members, where any 2-block split IS the discrete partition, so isolating the dead member is a COMPLETE declaration and N11c's own last row predicts 1.0. Recorded because that is where a reader would check the retraction and must find it does not apply.

N12c_third_shape_carrier.finding: every corpus-derived carrier scores EXACTLY the abstain-everywhere baseline (acc* 0.5, coverage 0.0, dead_trapped 4 of 4). Not one isolates a single dead method.
N12c_third_shape_carrier.only_resolving_carrier: discrete / per-symbol allowlist, acc* 1.0, coverage 1.0 -- and it is Vulture's shipped whitelist, killed on prior art in run 7
N12c_third_shape_carrier.corrected_law: acc*(Pi) = 1 - |D n mixed(Pi)|/|S|; equivalently coverage(Pi) = |{d in D : d's block is pure-dead}|/|D|. A partial interface is worth exactly the dead symbols it moves out of mixed blocks.
N12c_third_shape_carrier.objective_note: accuracy is reported only because the retraction is about it. The load-bearing objective is precision-1 coverage, because the deliverable is a certified set and only its precision is consumed.

N12d_two_accountings.value_accounting: |D n mixed(Pi)| is monotone NON-INCREASING under refinement, so a cheapest free carrier exists and is published
N12d_two_accountings.bit_accounting: #{mixed blocks of Pi ^ E} is NOT monotone: a 6-symbol fibre with dead members at 1 and 4 has 1 mixed block coarse and 2 refined
N12d_two_accountings.consequence: run 9's cheapest-carrier table and run 10's value table disagree about which carrier is cheapest with NEITHER being arithmetically wrong, because they minimise different quantities

n13_verdicts.claim_as_written: an edge (caller, callee) is DEFINITIVELY FALSE if leaf(callee) occurs nowhere in the caller's body, so unadjudicable_edges can be shrunk without running the oracle

fault_1_the_relation_was_substituted.false_reading: y is invoked while x is on the stack -- the relation a call graph denotes
fault_1_the_relation_was_substituted.true_reading: a CALL instruction or an attribute access m.y appears in x's own code object
fault_1_the_relation_was_substituted.counterexample: def x(h): return h()  /  def h(): return y()

fault_2_the_loops_own_repair_manufacture.verdict: REFUTED under BOTH readings, by eq. row 6
fault_2_the_loops_own_repair_manufacture.mechanism: row 6 normalised class instantiation to Cls.__init__, so 'return K()' is a real direct dispatch whose callee leaf appears nowhere in the caller's file; unguarded the refuter certifies a FALSE edge
fault_2_the_loops_own_repair_manufacture.wrong_first_counterexample: an ALIASED IMPORT, from M import y as a; a() -- NOT a counterexample, the import statement spells y, so the lemma holds. alias_bindings() kept as a diagnostic so the error stays auditable.

n13_verdicts.surviving_rule: admissible(x,y) := A1(C_x has no dynamic-name-construction site) and A2(y is text-faithful). Both are CHECKED refusal triggers and both OVER-refuse -- the opposite error direction from run 7's killed OPEN manifest, which failed unsoundly at precision 0.0.
n13_verdicts.why_the_mechanism_is_vacuous: F = {} on 2014 of 2014 real-repo edges, for two independent measured reasons: (a) the CPG adds (sym, callee) only where a resolved ast.Call sits in sym's body, so leaf(callee) is already a token of that body -- a necessary condition on an edge DERIVED from a call site is near-tautological; (b) A1 is a PRESENCE test, so 51-70% of real files are vetoed, fstring alone firing on 13/11/96/47 files.
n13_verdicts.the_real_proof_of_vacuity: every CPG-predicted edge is blockable by its own call site, so not_refuted_name_present accounts for 17/7/43/74 edges and A2 for 5/8/3/93; the residue is 0. The filter is strongest where it is least needed (fixtures) and dead where it could matter (real repos).
n13_verdicts.monotonicity: precision 0.3333 -> 0.5 under a sound refutation and -> 0.0 under an unsound one. A refuter touches the DENOMINATOR only, so precision is monotone non-decreasing IFF F & D = {} -- and that is the soundness condition, not an extra assumption.
n13_verdicts.n8_consequence: N8 is NOT unblocked, for the sixth consecutive run, and the blocker is now the DEFINITION of eq. row 17 rather than the absence of an oracle: an unjudged edge that is not false stays unjudged, so no refuter that needs no liveness can empty U.

self_inflicted_bugs_this_run: the module's FIRST counterexample for fault 2 was an aliased import, from M import y as a; a(). It is NOT a counterexample -- the import statement spells y, so the lemma HOLDS. The first cut of self_check reported fault2_refuted_without_a2 = False against a claim the assertion expected True, and the honest reading of that failure is that the counterexample was wrong, not the code. Replaced with the row-6 class-call normalisation, which is measured to be a real counterexample.

A2 was first implemented as a per-FILE alias test, on the theory that an alias makes a name available without spelling it. Same error: the alias appears IN the import statement, so the name is spelled. Split into a per-EDGE text-faithfulness test, which is where the hole actually lives.

the first draft of the A1 detection flagged getattr(o, 'query') as a construction site. It is not: the name is a string literal, so it is already a member of T(C) and the token rule sees it. Only a NON-constant second argument defeats T(C). Left unfixed this would have vetoed most of the standard library for nothing.
reported_against_interest: the node's stated purpose was to unblock N8 and it does not; identifiability_after is still False on both audited corpora and F is empty, so the filter had nothing to remove.

A2's exclusion of __init__ edges removes exactly the edges a call graph cares about most -- every instantiation of an imported class -- so the filter is weakest where call graphs are most used. That is the price of soundness and it is not tunable away.
soundness is checkable on 2 of 10 corpora. The other 8 are UNVALIDATED, not vacuously sound, because run 10's N12e is the precedent for a vacuous truth published as a result.
